title: Video Animation | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Video Animation. Category: Designing. Duration: 4 months. Description: Helps students master modern video production using industry-standard editing tools and cutting-edge AI technologies: cinematic video editing, motion graphics, and AI-powered audio enhancement. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
